units.passage: Utilize AI technologies ethically, respecting privacy, confidentiality, and intellectual property rights.
units.why: A general call to 'Utilize AI technologies ethically' naming privacy, confidentiality and IP without specific instructions, so P116.
units.fit_note: Names privacy, confidentiality and IP as areas but gives no concrete rule.

units.passage: These tools can assist with brainstorming, finding information, and even reading and creating materials; however, they must be used appropriately and ethically, and you must understand their limitations.
units.why: General call: tools 'must be used appropriately and ethically' and users 'must understand their limitations', with no specific content: P116.

units.passage: While AI tools can significantly aid students in various aspects of their learning journey they also must be used appropriately.
units.why: States AI tools "must be used appropriately"; a general expectation of appropriate use with no specific content, so P116.
units.fit_note: The same sentence also says AI tools "can significantly aid students in various aspects of their learning journey", a benefit claim (B coded this as P87).

units.passage: Use AI generated content in a responsible way.
units.why: "Use AI generated content in a responsible way" is a general call to responsible use with no specific content, P116.

units.passage: Before using natural language AI programs for academic, research, or administrative purposes, it is important to understand your responsibilities and the related guidelines for ethical use, both in terms of policy and in terms of disciplinary standards and expectations.
units.why: "it is important to understand your responsibilities and the related guidelines for ethical use" is a general call for responsible use with no specific content, so P116.

units.passage: and use AI tools in ethical ways that do not compromise intellectual property rights, data privacy, or our academic rigor and honor.
units.why: "use AI tools in ethical ways that do not compromise intellectual property rights, data privacy, or our academic rigor" is a general call for ethical use with generic concerns, so P116.
units.fit_note: Names intellectual property, data privacy and academic honor as the limits on ethical use.

units.passage: respetando los lineamientos de integridad y honestidad
units.policy: Students must use AI ethically and responsibly, respecting academic integrity and honesty guidelines.
units.why: It says students must use AI "de forma ética y responsable, respetando los lineamientos de integridad y honestidad académica"; a general ethics expectation with no specific content, P116.

units.passage: La Universidad fomentará el uso responsable, ético y legal de la IA, y garantizará
units.policy: The University promotes responsible, ethical and legal use of AI and guarantees compliance with intellectual property rights, including patents, copyright and institutional academic integrity policies.
units.why: "La Universidad fomentará el uso responsable, ético y legal de la IA" and guarantee IP rights and integrity policies; a general ethical-use expectation, P116. Final coding: P116, modality should, unit_stance encourage.
units.fit_note: Also guarantees compliance with IP rights (patents, copyright), which P116 does not capture.

units.passage: Overall, AI tools should be used wisely and reflectively with an aim to deepen understanding of subject matter.
units.why: Sample: 'AI tools should be used wisely and reflectively with an aim to deepen understanding of subject matter' is a general call for responsible use, P116.

units.passage: All members of the USD community are expected to maintain professional and academic integrity when using these tools.
units.why: "expected to maintain professional and academic integrity when using these tools" is a general ethical expectation with no specific content, P116.

units.passage: USD supports the freedom to explore, debate, critique and discuss ideas relevant to a course or field of study and expects that freedom to be exercised with professionalism and responsibility.
units.why: "USD supports the freedom to explore, debate, critique and discuss ideas ... and expects that freedom to be exercised with professionalism and responsibility" states an academic-freedom principle with a responsibility expectation, P116.

units.passage: In higher education, it’s our responsibility to help students engage with these technologies ethically, transparently, and with critical judgment.
units.why: 'it's our responsibility to help students engage with these technologies ethically, transparently, and with critical judgment' is a general call for ethical use, P116.

units.passage: Students are expected to adhere to the prescribed professional and ethical standards of the profession/discipline
units.why: The statement asks students to 'adhere to the prescribed professional and ethical standards of the profession/discipline'; this is a general call to responsible conduct with no AI-specific content, so P116.
units.fit_note: Ties conduct to the norms of the student's profession or discipline.

units.passage: As with all other tools, you must abide by all applicable laws and policies when you use AI, and you should strive to use AI ethically.
units.policy: Users should strive to use AI ethically.
units.why: "you should strive to use AI ethically" is a general call to ethical use with no specific content, which is P116; it is a soft "should".

units.passage: You should exercise sound judgment in your use of AI.
units.why: "exercise sound judgment in your use of AI" is a general call for good judgment with no specific content, so P116 rather than P118, which requires weighing benefits and risks.

units.passage: Faculty and students must disclose how and when AI is used in research, service work, reviews, data collection, and creative expression and are responsible for using it appropriately and ethically.
units.why: "are responsible for using it appropriately and ethically" is a generic ethical-use expectation, P116.

units.passage: AI should be used ethically and reasonably.
units.why: "AI should be used ethically and reasonably" is a general call for ethical and reasonable use with no specific content, which is P116.

units.passage: Faculty should exercise due diligence in understanding and addressing the multiple ethical considerations involved when using Gen AI for teaching and learning purposes.
units.why: "Faculty should exercise due diligence in understanding and addressing the multiple ethical considerations" is a general expectation of ethical use with no detail, so P116.

units.passage: Promote ethical AI use , including respecting intellectual property and avoiding plagiarism.
units.why: 'Promote ethical AI use, including respecting intellectual property and avoiding plagiarism' (P116, general ethical expectation).
units.fit_note: Names IP and plagiarism, a bit more specific than a bare ethics call.

units.passage: As part of the university’s commitment to the ethical and responsible use of Generative AI, the following guidelines should be adhered to when utilizing Generative AI tools
units.why: "the following guidelines should be adhered to when utilizing Generative AI tools" sets the purpose and scope of an institution-wide set of principles, so P56 (framework) rather than a specific rule type.
